about: Until when each compiler and runtime we build with is supported by its maker. The gate fails once a date has passed: an unsupported one gets no security fixes. Estimates are marked and are corrected when the maker publishes the real date.

items.name: Go 1.27
items.source: https://go.dev/doc/devel/release#policy : each release is supported until two newer ones exist; 1.29 is expected in August 2027

items.name: Electron 45
items.source: https://www.electronjs.org/docs/latest/tutorial/electron-timelines : the latest three majors are supported; 45.0.0 came out 2026-10-21 and a major follows about every 8 weeks, so 48 is expected about 2027-04-07
